author: AstralRead
description: Astrology for AI assistants, read-only and without an account: natal chart (planets, houses, angles, aspects), today's transits to a chart, the sky of a day, the Vedic chart with nakshatras and Vimshottari dasha, and links to AstralRead's knowledge base. English and Russian; birth data is not stored.

tools.name: natal_chart
tools.title: Natal chart
tools.description: Calculates a natal (birth) chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: the exact sign, degree and house of the Sun, Moon, planets, North Node and Chiron; the Ascendant, MC, DSC and IC; the 12 house cusps; and the major aspects between the planets with their orbs. Adds short notes and links from the AstralRead knowledge base for the Sun, Moon and Ascendant signs. Use it when someone asks for their birth chart or about their placements. Needs the birth date, the place (or coordinates) and ideally the birth time. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown: then houses, Ascendant and MC are not computed.
birth_time.title: Birth Time

place.description: Birth city, e.g. 'Chicago, Illinois, USA'. Used to look up coordinates and the time zone. Not needed if latitude/longitude are given.
place.title: Place

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place, e.g. America/Chicago. Looked up from the place/coordinates when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone

house_system.description: House system: koch (default), placidus or whole_sign.
house_system.title: House System

lang.description: Language of the result: en or ru.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: transits_today
tools.title: Transits to a natal chart
tools.description: Lists the tight transits of a given day to a natal chart: aspects of the transiting Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn to the natal planets, Ascendant and MC within 2° (3° for Jupiter and Saturn), plus each planet's current sign and natal house and the Moon phase. Use it for questions like 'what are my transits today' or 'what is happening in my chart this week'. The date defaults to today in the person's time zone. Computed with the Swiss Ephemeris; no forecast text is generated. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

tools.name: vedic_chart
tools.title: Vedic (Jyotish) chart
tools.description: Calculates a Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna (Ascendant), the rashi, degree and house of the nine grahas (Sun to Saturn, Rahu as the mean node and Ketu opposite), and the nakshatra, pada and nakshatra lord of the Lagna and every graha, with the traditional symbol and deity of the Moon's nakshatra. Use it for questions like 'what is my nakshatra', 'my Vedic chart' or 'my rashi / Moon sign in Jyotish'. Pure calculation: no doshas, yogas or predictions. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

tools.name: vimshottari_dasha
tools.title: Vimshottari dasha periods
tools.description: Calculates the Vimshottari dasha periods of a birth chart (Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsa): the Moon's nakshatra at birth, the balance of the first Mahadasha, the full Mahadasha sequence from birth with start and end dates, and the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha running on a given date plus the next two Antardashas. Use it for questions like 'which Mahadasha am I in' or 'when does my Saturn dasha start'. Dates use a 365.25-day year. The result lists the classical themes of the running periods, not predictions. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

tools.name: sky_today
tools.title: Sky of the day
tools.description: Returns the sky of one calendar day from the Swiss Ephemeris: the Moon's sign, phase and illumination, lunations and eclipses, planet sign changes, retrograde/direct stations, exact aspects between planets, which planets are retrograde, and every planet's position, plus a link to the AstralRead 'Sky of the day' page. No birth data needed. English uses UTC times, Russian uses Moscow time.

tools.name: kb_lookup
tools.title: Astrology knowledge base lookup
tools.description: Finds pages of the AstralRead astrology knowledge base for a chart factor and returns each page's title, a one- or two-sentence summary and its link. Understands planets in signs and houses ('Moon in Taurus', 'Mars in 10th house'), Ascendant/MC signs, aspects ('Venus square Saturn'), houses ('7th house'), patterns ('grand trine', 'T-square', 'yod'), North Node and Chiron placements, and transits ('Saturn transit Aries', 'transiting Saturn square Venus', 'Saturn return'). English or Russian.
